transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. Well, what really scared me enough to make an appointment is that I’ve started having these thoughts lately. I catch myself thinking that... well, that it would just be simpler if I didn’t wake up tomorrow. I want to be clear that I don't have any actual plan to harm myself, but just having those kinds of thoughts was enough to make me realize I needed to come see someone.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts and feelings?
Well, I'd say this has been going on for about eight months now. It started right around the time my brother’s health and behavior changed so suddenly.
Have you noticed any changes in your interest or enjoyment in activities you used to like, such as hobbies, work, or spending time with family and friends?

Yes, I have. I used to really enjoy painting, but lately... well, I still set out my watercolor things sometimes, hoping I'll want to paint. But I’ll just sit there staring at the paper, and eventually I just put it all away. The pleasure I used to feel in the color and the light, it just doesn’t seem to arrive anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels or have you been feeling unusually tired or fatigued lately, even if you haven’t been doing much physically?
No, not really. My energy levels seem about the same as they usually are. I mean, I haven't been feeling unusually tired or physically drained during the day. So, no, physically I feel fine.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up frequently during the night, or sleeping more than usual?

Yes, I have. Getting to sleep is a bit uneven lately. And then I almost always wake up around three or four in the morning. My mind just starts going over phone calls, forms I need to deal with, wondering if I handled things correctly... By the time morning comes, I feel as if I've hardly rested at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, such as a significant decrease in appetite or weight loss?

No, I haven't noticed any changes there. I'm still eating my normal meals. And my weight hasn't fluctuated... my clothes still fit exactly the same, so I definitely haven't lost any weight. My appetite has been pretty steady.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you're not living up to your own or others' expectations?

Yes, I suppose I have. I keep going back over my brother’s decline recently. I just keep telling myself that if I had been a better sister, or more attentive to him, I would have noticed something was wrong sooner. I can't help but feel like I could have prevented some of this if I had just paid closer attention.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or conversely, feeling restless or fidgety lately?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't feel like I'm moving or talking any slower than normal. And I'm not feeling restless or fidgety either. I just feel pretty much the same physically in that regard.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had thoughts about not wanting to go on?

No, I don't think so. I've had sad days, of course, just like anyone else, but... nothing that lasted this long or felt quite like this. And I've certainly never had thoughts about not wanting to be here before. This is the first time I've dealt with a stretch like this.
Have you ever had a period in the past when you felt persistently down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if you didn’t seek help for it?

No, like I was just saying, I really don't think so. Even if I try to think back to times when I might have just pushed through things without seeing a doctor... I've never had a stretch lasting weeks where I felt this down or disconnected. This really is the first time it's ever been like this for me.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, even if you didn’t talk to a doctor about it?

I believe you just asked me that, doctor. But no, the answer is still no. Like I mentioned a moment ago, I've never gone through a two-week stretch like this before in my life. This is all completely new to me.
Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period when you felt down, lost interest in things, or experienced similar symptoms for at least two weeks in a row?
Doctor, I feel like we're going in circles here. As I've said, no, I haven't. I've never had a two-week period where I felt like this before. This is the very first time.
Have you ever experienced a time in your life before this current period where you had a low mood, loss of interest in activities, or similar symptoms that lasted for at least two weeks?

I... I really don't know how else to say it. We've gone over this several times now. No, I have never experienced this before. Never for two weeks, never at all. This is the first time in my 68 years that I've felt this way.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or unusually irritable for several days or more, where it was out of character for you?

No, I haven't. I've never had a time where I felt unusually high or had extreme energy like you're describing. I've always been pretty even-keeled my whole life, so something like that would definitely stand out to me. But no, nothing like that.
Has this episode of feeling down and losing interest in things followed any kind of seasonal pattern, like starting around the same time each year?

No, it hasn't. I mean, since this is the very first time in my life I've ever felt this way, there really isn't any kind of pattern to it. It's just happening now, not something that comes around every year.

Can you recall if there was a time before this current period when you had a low mood or lost interest in activities for at least two weeks, even if it was brief or you didn’t talk to anyone about it?

Doctor, I know we just talked about this a moment ago. No, there hasn't been a time before this. Like I said, this is the very first time in my life I've ever felt like this. Never before, not even briefly.
